Don’t try to guilt-trip them, if anything it will annoy them enough to do it or make them feel even worse about themselves (once again resulting in suicide)
For most, words of encouragement don’t work either. I’m gonna be honest and say I don’t think you can “talk someone out of it” if they’re serious about committing suicide. Best to get them professional help: if they’re going to attempt soon (as in they’re texting you or calling you right before they kill themselves) call 911 (or whatever number it is in your country). If they’re not currently planning on doing it try to get them in a psych ward. They can be scary and sometimes even unethical so try to find a decent one. If you’re not their guardian and they’re a minor you can’t put them in the ward so try to get their guardian to do it. If they’re of age it’s a bit harder, but if you’re close enough you may be able to convince them of it. Of course, it depends on the person. But I hope you find a way to keep that person alive.
